A Smarter, Easier and Safer Way to Volunteer

paragraphs: Sterling Volunteers sells volunteer background screening services to nonprofits and volunteer programs across the country. The screening platform is described as tailor-made for volunteer managers, nonprofits and service organizations that want to avoid onboarding risky individuals. Volunteers who are screened and vetted join an online community and can connect with multiple service organizations.

Sectors named on the site include education, where volunteers are screened at colleges and universities, secondary schools, libraries, and research institutions. Healthcare screening covers volunteers working at hospitals, clinics, laboratories, nursing facilities and relief organizations. Sports screening covers youth coaches, referees, and others volunteering with amateur, Olympic and youth sports teams.

Pricing depends on the breadth and depth of the checks, and the cost may be as low as $10 per background check. Two screening packages are offered to clients, an Advanced Package and a Complete Package. The majority of searches are returned in 24 to 72 hours.

quote.text: Sterling Volunteers offers volunteer screening services to nonprofits and volunteer programs all across the country.
